title: Shrimp Fried Rice
description: Better-than-takeout fried rice with juicy shrimp, egg and vegetables. Leftover rice works best.

ingredients.prep: sliced, white and green parts separated

steps.text: Cook the rice as usual (or use about 4 cups of leftover rice). Spread it on a sheet pan to cool and dry out while you prep.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Cook the shrimp until pink, about 2 minutes per side, then move to a plate.
Add another 1 tbsp oil and scramble the eggs until just set. Break them into pieces and add to the shrimp.
Add the remaining oil, the peas and carrots, the white parts of the green onions and the garlic. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the rice and press it into the pan. Let it crisp for a minute before tossing, and repeat a few times. Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, shrimp and eggs, and top with the green onion tops.
